one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-20 to 2026-12-20. Scheduled: (1) Marvell Q3 FY27 results and Q4 guide on 2026-12-01 (company release). Q3 is largely known: Marvell said on 11-02 that preliminary Q3 revenue was in line and narrowed the range to $3.15B +/-2% (Stocktwits), so the swing factor is the Q4 guide and any FY28 update after the Lumentum signing; Marvell has beaten its own revenue midpoint in each of the last 8 quarters by a median ~0.9% (guidance_check). (2) Lumentum/Marvell S-4 filing and SAMR/HSR news: the LITE-MRVL spread widened to 16.3% on 11-20 (Twelve Data), so deal news moves MRVL both ways. (3) Sector: the AI-semis sell-off after Jensen Huang's exit as NVIDIA CEO (Motley Fool 11-16; Polymarket had priced it at 74% by year-end) and NVIDIA's own results on 11-19 left the group de-rated; MRVL fell 11.7% on 11-20 with QQQ -5.7%. Short-horizon regularities: after a -51% move in four weeks, one-month reversal is the stronger effect; the 11-23 session already traded at ~$145 intraday on light early volume (Twelve Data), which we weight only partly. Model: lognormal, median $130 (+6% vs the 11-20 close), sigma 0.27 (86% annual vol / 3.5 = 0.25 plus the earnings event). P(>= 122.28) = 0.59.

fair_value.method: Quarterly driver build (customer AI capex x Marvell share of wallet for Data Center; C&O, non-GAAP GM and opex) valued at the horizon with a 20.8x NTM P/E on the build's own EPS (weight 0.45, $198.23), the same 20.8x on mid-cycle EPS at a 32% margin (0.15, $127.07) and a 1.94% peer-median FCF yield on LTM levered FCF (0.40, $289.02), less the Celestial earn-out and the signed Lumentum all-stock merger at expected value (p 0.70, -$35.10 a share if pending; standalone $248.6): research target (12m) $223.87.

reasoning: As of 2026-11-20 MRVL closed at $122.28, -51% from $251.65 on 10-28: the Lumentum all-stock merger (signed 11-02, 4.5 MRVL per LITE, ~33% dilution, close H1 2028) took it to $171, then the AI-semis sell-off after Jensen Huang's exit as NVIDIA CEO (Polymarket had priced 74% by year-end) and an -11.7% day on 11-20. We keep the quarterly driver build (AI capex x share of wallet; FY27 $12.07B, FY28 $19.8B, FY29 $28.3B, ~9% under the consensus FY29 path) and re-price the multiples: peers on dated pages now sit at a 17.52x median forward P/E (NVDA 8.65x after the CEO exit), so the horizon P/E falls from 29x to 20.8x (k=0.8 shrink toward MRVL's 21.68x). The tech FCF-leg rule adds a 1.94% FCF-yield leg (40%), which lifts value ~$43. The merger is valued on a same-horizon basis (LITE NTM EPS $33.4 x 18.29x = $61.7B plus +$3.0B net synergies against 454.5M new shares at the $248.60 standalone value): -$35 a share if pending, p 0.70 given the 16.3% arbitrage spread (Twelve Data) and SAMR history. Research target (12m) $223.87; P10 $77.24 (capex digestion, share loss, ~13.8x), P90 $422.81 (high-case capex, re-rating to ~30x). The left tail is fatter, and the gap to the $122 price is the market's doubt about the merger and the AI cycle that our base case does not share. Lane: Polymarket, the deal spread from quote data, Stocktwits sentiment, independent newsletters (TIKR, InsideArbitrage, Let's Data Science, Substacks on DSP share), Futurum and Constellation analysts, job postings and web traffic; social items stay context and only the spread moves a number (the deal probability).
